searchText: yes, you need to verify that the distance matches on the caller side. in discv4, the FINDNODE request was defined as 'give me the closest nodes to this hash that you know about'. there is nothing you can verify about the answer. the caller could just return random nodes and you wouldn't know. Thanks fjl 👍
